g.text: UK Met Office stations reporting a snow observation for Christmas Day.
Only blue and orange count towards the Met Office's 'snow falling' percentage.
Data: Met Office MIDAS Open, UK daily weather observations (v202607), via CEDA. Open Government Licence.
Orange = automated observation (quality flag 1006 = automatic sensor, passed QC, per Met Office NCIC; also 2006 corrections, a small minority).
Code 9 = part-day observing or, at automatic sites, a missing hourly sensor reading on a snow-free day. MIDAS Open holds about 96% of the archive.
